description: WorldGen++ adds a dedicated tab to the New Game window. Adjust world size, location count, node density, and set counts for mines, rigs, wrecks, treasure, villages and pirates. Pick a loot multiplier, choose per-location POI types from a wide selection, preview your map before committing, save or load up to three named setting profiles, and preset shipyard cargo capacity for Cheat++ on new saves (same shipyard_cap.txt path), and more.
description_short: Customize your world map before starting — size, density, resource types, map preview, save/load profiles, and more
